Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) Note: This Agreement represents a Service Level Agreement (“SLA” or “Agreement”) between the buyer a nd Cab & Taxi Hiring Service provider. The purpose of this agreement is to facilitate implementation of Month ly Cab & Taxi Hiring Service from the buyer’s premises or any other premises designated by buyer. This Agre ement outlines the scope of work, buyer’s obligations, special terms and conditions related to service delivery and payment of services for mutual understanding of the stakeholders. The Agreement remains valid till com pletion of scope of services or end of contractual duration (whichever is earlier) unless either superseded by a revised agreement mutually endorsed by the stakeholders or terminated by either of the parties thereof. The Services contracts placed through GeM shall be governed by following set of Terms and Conditions: 1. General terms and conditions for Services 2. Service Specific STC of the Services contracts shall include the service level agreement (SLA) for the service 3. BID / Reverse Auction specific Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC). The above terms and conditions are in reverse order of precedence i.e. ATC supersedes Service sp ecific STC which supersede GTC, whenever there are any conflicting provisions. The above set of t erms and conditions along with scope of work and service level agreement as enumerated in the d ocument shall be construed to be part of the Contract between Buyer and Service Provider.

Note: This contract will be governed as per Service level Agreement of G eM. In case of any contradiction between scope of work stipulated herewi th and the Service level Agreement than GEMs Service Level Agreement will be followed. SCOPE OF WORK 1 Hiring of 01 nos. passenger four-wheeler vehicle for running as per BID docu ment for ADSTE/TELE/JBP of Jabalpur division to run on entire Jabalpur divisi on. Pickups also can be run outside JBP division as and when required. (Base station as mentioned can also be changed as per convenience of administrat ion during the contract period). Charges Extra KMs will be paid as per Servic e level agreement of GEM. Charges for monthly running to be calculate d for 03 months basis, this means if any vehicle runs less than 1600 kms in any month than balance kilometers will be carry forward up t o 03 months as per details provided in monthly certificate (Annexure-B). The extra kilometers of schedule item are used in case of failure/accident/br eakdown/emergency and bound to contractor to execute whenever required as per schedule. If contractor shall not arrange vehicle for running extra KM whenever required, the penalty will be equivalent to one day running charges plus 2 5% of it, will be imposed and this will be deducted from contractor’s bill for days bal anced current month cycle. 2 DEFINATION OF SIMILAR WORK – ANY WORK OF HIRING OF PASSENGER VEHICLE, UTILIT Y VEHICLE SUCH AS PICK-UP VAN, TRUCK, LORRIES, ETC. FOR GOVT. DEPARTMENT. CONDITIONS WILL BE DEALT AS PER SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT AND INDIAN RAILWAY SERVICES GCC 3 1. Sr. Divisional Signal & Telecom Engineer/Co./JBP will be the Engineer in-charge of the work. 2. Sr. Divisional Finance Manager / Jabalpur will be the Associate Finance Officer. 3. Measurement shall be certified by ADSTE/TELE/JBP or nominated officer in Mea surement Book. 4. The Engineer – in- charge of the work may substitute these engineers/supervis ors at a later date as per Rly requirement. 4 The vehicle is required to run as per the instructions of the in charge of the vehicle. 5 The vehicle is to be run between various stations over Jabalpur Division mainly. In case of require ment, it may be used over other divisional jurisdiction as per the instruction of the officer who will be using it. The station where this vehicle is required to be kept for supervision will be at the discr etion of administration. Further the starting station (Base station as mentioned in Para 1 above) ca n also be changed as per convenience of administration.

6 Vehicle may also be required to keep over night at any station as per the field requirements. For s uch overnight stays, all arrangements of driver and vehicle have to be done by contractor at his o wn cost. 7 Vehicle will be made available by the contractor all days of the week. As per requirement vehicle may be asked anytime. Weekly rest will be given as per convenience of railway. During the rest pe riod of driver, an alternate driver should be arranged by the contractor, if required. The vehicle m ust be required for monthly plan 1600KM *360 Hrs. with outstation -24 Hrs. If some time vehicle u sed continuously more than 12 hrs in a day, then hours shall be adjusted in next days as per conv enience of railway and mutually agreed between Railway representative and Contractor (or his dri ver) subjected to total monthly Hours is 360 hrs. Monthly base package is inclusive of night charges. 8 Vehicles will have to be made available as early as possible and within Seven days of issue of acce ptance letter. 9 The tenderer has to arrange vehicle, its accessories as per the requirement of running of vehicle a nd keep the vehicle in good condition 10 The complete maintenance of the vehicle will be the responsibility of the tenderer. 11 The vehicle will be permitted to be withdrawn for servicing and maintenance etc. only after alterna tive vehicle is provided. As far as same type of vehicle shall be arranged as mentioned in the sche dule. However, in case of acceptance of officer who will be using it in charge of vehicle equivalent type of vehicle may be accepted. The fitness and configuration of vehicle is verified by con signee and officer who will be using it at the time of vehicle provided or on replacemen t of vehicle as per Annexure-A. The fitness certificate as per Annexure-A should be sub mitted every quarter by contractor duly verified by Consignee and officer who will be u sing it. If provided vehicle is found in unsatisfactory condition than it shall be replaced within 3 days., then penalty will be imposed beyond 03 days till replacement., Penalty w ill be equivalent to one day running charges plus 25% of it will be imposed for each day beyond 03 days and this will be deducted from contractor’s bill. All the matters regardi ng running of vehicle, time of vehicle availability and stipulated conditions will be deal t as per existing tender. Railway decision shall be final. 12 Logbook will be maintained and provided for vehicle by the contractor and counter signed by Rail way representative. Log book shall be returned to Railway when contract expire. 13 Railway administration shall not be responsible for any accident, damage etc. to the vehicle durin g the period of hire. 14 If any damages are caused to the Railway module/ card/ equipment handed over for repairs an ap propriate amount as decided shall be deducted from payments due to the contractor. 15 The place of keeping the vehicle and the officer who will be using it/consignee may be changed at the discretion of administration. 16 Vehicle should be in self-starting, good working condition to run on Kachcha Road also. 17 The vehicle should be new, manufacturing year of vehicle should not older than Two ye ar from date of tender opening. Vehicle purchase receipt from the agency to be submit ted by contractor which will be crossed verified by Consignee. The vehicle must be arra nged in consultation with the concerned officer who will be using the vehicle. This ens ures that the vehicle meets the specific needs and preferences of the officer

18 In case the vehicle gets out of order, an alternative vehicle must be arranged within a reasonable time i.e. one hour for arrangement plus running time. All relevant documents of the alternate vehi cle to be available as per the statutory requirement before bringing vehicle for use by Railways. A s an alternative, due to contractor’s failure to provide alternative vehicle for more than stipulated time period, Railway administration shall have liberty to arrange any other v ehicle and the expenditure incurred by the Railway in arranging alternative vehicle will be deducted from the contractor’s bill. 19 The interiors, exteriors, and furnishings of the vehicles should be excellent. The interio r & exteriors of Vehicle shall be kept neat and clean. The seat covers are also kept nea t and clean. The painting and fittings of vehicle shall be maintained in good condition. 20 Driver shall be punctual, well behaved, and decent. He shall obey all lawful instructions of the offic er who will be using the vehicle. If driver fails to do so the contractor shall replace the driver imme diately. 21 Petrol, diesel, Mobil Oil etc. for the use in vehicle along with the Driver from the time of hiring shall be provided by contractor of vehicle at his own cost including the wages of staff. 22 The Fastcard/Toll charges shall be borne by contractor (if any) irrespective of no of tim e visits on same route. The sole responsibility of Fastcard charges/Toll charges shall be of contractor. 23 Counting of Kms. For payment purposes will start from BASE STATION OF VEHICLE. 24 The tenderer shall have comprehensive insurance for the vehicle throughout of the operating perio d. The tenderer has to submit the insurance papers. In case any default all responsibility will be of the tenderer. The contractors will produce for perusal of the Railway the original insurance policy a nd proof of payment of all insurance premium charges in respect thereof as and when demanded b y Railway. 25 Notwithstanding anything contained in the other clauses of the agreement in the event of unsatisf actory service or any failure / breach of non-observation at any time by the contractor of the term s and provision of this agreement to the satisfaction of the administration in all respects (which sh all be the sole judge and whose decision shall be final, then it shall be lawful for the administration without prejudice to all or any other rights and remedies to make any other arrangements it may consider necessary. Railway administration may terminate this contract giving seven days’ notice to the contractor and in case of such termination the performance guarantee & security deposit sh all be forfeited by the administration and contractors shall have no claim what so ever against the administration in consequence of such termination of the contract. Further other than above, if Rai lway administration does not require services of hired vehicles, then agreement will be terminated with one-month notice. 26 The contractor/Firm should have/arrange necessary Documents/permit such as RC, Dra wing License, Vehicle Insurance, PUC, Commercial/Taxi permit, etc. for the states unde r the jurisdiction of Jabalpur Division. 27 Payment will be paid monthly of schedule items after receiving certificate from Concer ned in-charge as per Annexure-B. Payment shall be done after deducting any penalty c harges for lapse on the part of the firm as given above. 28 Payment of on account bill for the Tendered work will be arranged by the Sr. Divisional Signal & Te lecom Engineer/Co-Ord./JBP in charge of the work through the associate Accounts Officer. The nom inated representative shall verify and forward the bills to office of Sr. DSTE/Co./JBP for arranging p ayment.

29 Penalty whichever is applicable shall be deducted from the on-account bills. 30 In case of non-deployment of vehicle for 30 minutes or more when neither replacement vehicles p rovided nor hiring through third party could be done in that case penalty will be equivalent to on e day running charges plus 25% of it will be imposed and this will be deducted from co ntractor’s bill. All the matters regarding running of vehicle, time of vehicle availability and stipulated conditions will be dealt as per existing tender. 31. Rights of the Railway to deal with Tender: The authority for th e acceptance of the tender will rest with the Railway. It shall n ot be obligatory on the said authority to accept the lowest ten der or any other tender, and tenderer(s) shall neither demand any explanation for the cause of rejection of his/ their tender nor the Railway to assign reasons for declining to consider or r eject any particular tender or tenders. If the tenderer(s) delibe rately gives / give wrong information in his / their tender or cr eates / create circumstances for the acceptance of his / their t ender, the Railway reserves the right to reject such tender at any stage. 32. Railway reserves the right to make or not to make any further reference to the tenderer regarding the fulfilment of the Minimum Eligibility Criteria and to award the tender onl y on the basis of the documents submitted by the tenderer al ong with the bid.
